name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm sends Alliance fighters to clear the Bloodfury harpies from the ruined Charred Vale. Their removal will open a path for druids and caretakers to begin healing the scorched land.

sections.title: The Wounded Valley
sections.body: South of Stonetalon Peak, the Charred Vale lies in ash and smoldering ruins where a lush alpine haven once stood. A mechanized logging and mining army swept through the sacred crags, stripping trees and setting uncontrolled fires. For the guardians around Stonetalon, ancient woodland lost to industrial greed is a wound they cannot ignore.

sections.title: The Harpy Menace
sections.body: Bloodfury harpies took hold in the ashes left by the mechanical fires. Opportunistic and vicious, they swarm the smoking lowlands, nest there, and aggressively ambush anyone who approaches the valley. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot walk the soil to sow seeds of renewal; the harpies violently bar passage to every outsider.

sections.title: Clearing the Path to Renewal
sections.body: Restoration cannot begin until the Bloodfury roosts are broken. Albagorm sends seasoned Alliance fighters deep among the tribe to slay its hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers. Thinning their predatory flock is the first step toward reclaiming the land for nature and giving the forest spirits room to breathe once more.

faq.answer: The Charred Vale lies in the southwestern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. Fire consumed the once-lush forest and scorched it to bedrock as industrial logging forces exploited the land without restraint.

aliases: who gives reclaiming the charred vale
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm is a woodland keeper and caretaker at the Alliance settlement on Stonetalon Peak. He protects nature and forest spirits, works to curb desolation in the mountains, and drives back encroaching beasts.

faq.q: Why are harpies living in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Bloodfury harpies thrive in disrupted, blighted lands. After fire leveled the valley, the opportunistic flock moved into the basin and attacks anyone who tries to enter.

faq.q: Who set fire to the Charred Vale in the first place?
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm names a greedy mechanized army of industrialists as the cause. Their unchecked logging machinery and explosive expansion brought devastating blazes that consumed the woodland.

faq.q: What must be done after thinning the harpies?
faq.answer: Once the Bloodfury numbers are curbed, Keeper Albagorm turns to planting seeds and channeling restorative magic to coax new life from the scorched soil.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: No. Keeper Albagorm works from the Alliance redoubt atop Stonetalon Peak, so Alliance heroes alone can clear the Bloodfury harpies for him.

angles.text: As a night elf, you revere Stonetalon's wild forests. Driving vile harpies from sacred groves defiled by foreign engines is an urgent calling.
As a druid, you serve the Cenarion circle and defend nature's harmony. You help the Keepers clear blighted nests so magical reforestation can begin.
As an Alliance hero, you help secure the high passes and southern valleys, protecting vulnerable night elf settlements and sanctuaries across Stonetalon Peak from predatory threats.
